classes.name: Archer
classes.about: The archer has a long-range attack and can acquire very powerful weapons.

classes.name: Assassin
classes.about: The assassin fights from medium range and uses poison to damage his enemies over time.

classes.name: Bard
classes.about: The bard uses his lute to inspire allies and enhance their combat capabilities.

classes.name: Druid
classes.about: The druid shapeshifts between forms to adapt to any battle.

classes.name: Huntress
classes.about: The huntress uses arrows and traps to defeat her enemies.

classes.name: Kensei
classes.about: The kensei dashes and slashes enemies at close range to bolster his combat effectiveness.

classes.name: Knight
classes.about: The knight fights at close range, wears very heavy armor, and uses his shield to stun enemies.

classes.name: Mystic
classes.about: The mystic fights with a staff and uses her crystal orb to bind enemies to a distant plane.

classes.name: Necromancer
classes.about: The necromancer drains life from his enemies to heal himself and his allies.

classes.name: Ninja
classes.about: The ninja relies on speed and skill, using katanas and ninja stars to deal big damage.

classes.name: Paladin
classes.about: The paladin can deal damage at close range, wear armor and heal himself and his allies.

classes.name: Priest
classes.about: The priest attacks at long range and can heal himself and his allies.

classes.name: Rogue
classes.about: The rogue relies on his speed to deal damage at medium range while avoiding attacks.

classes.name: Samurai
classes.about: The samurai fights with a katana and uses his wakizashi sidearm to expose enemy weak points.

classes.name: Sorcerer
classes.about: The sorcerer uses his scepter to fire blasts of chain lightning at his enemies.

classes.name: Summoner
classes.about: The summoner spawns monsters to fight for her and boost her damage output.

classes.name: Trickster
classes.about: The trickster fights with a dagger while using her magical prism to distract enemies.

classes.name: Warrior
classes.about: The warrior wears strong armor and uses his magic helmet to inspire his allies in battle.

classes.name: Wizard
classes.about: The wizard deals damage from a long distance and blasts enemies with powerful spells.
